method: Engine CPU only. Unchanged v255 deterministic 2/6-season fixtures; independent archived complete baseline source. Alternating before/after, isolated process per workflow; module loading, transpilation, fixture creation and explicit GC outside timing. Cold is first query; warm and revisit are unchanged queries from the same source references (a new consumer has no engine-local state). Selection changes News ranking/performance options or Latest Changes/Recap season to Season 1. Edit immutably removes the latest selected-season first-team League goal and returns to original selection. Every phase compares the complete JSON SHA256. No SSR, browser paint, storage I/O or live data.
